title: Ada and the Contact
author: Astrid Ishikawa
blurb: Zephyrine Villalobos, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, works cases no one wants attributed. But when a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
